policy: Do not reuse combat clips that still look like attacks.

jump.notes: No safe jump clip in adapted GLB. launch maps to Death and is not used. Airborne uses run at reduced speed with upward presentation lean.

boost.notes: super/heavy are attack/spell clips and are not used. Boost is faster run plus racing sole VFX.

stumble.notes: Hit reaction reads as stumble, not an attack.

recovery.notes: No dedicated recovery clip; walk is the honest locomotion return.

finish_victory.notes: super/taunt still read combat-adjacent; idle plus victory pose overlay.

finish_defeat.notes: launch/Death is not used. Hurt clip plus slumped overlay.

selection_pose.notes: Idle plus runner start_pose overlay. charged_idle is combat idle and is not used.
